endpoints.description: Responders are defined as the percentage of participants among all participants receiving Gleolan (the Intent to Image Population) who had at least one indeterminate tissue or unexpected fluorescent end of surgery (EOS) tissue where Gleolan-induced PpIX fluorescence status was consistent with central laboratory histology. For a participant to be considered a success, only biopsies considered 'non-obvious' for tumor status by an external panel of neurosurgeons who reviewed videos and images were eligible to be assessed in the numerator. A two-sided 95% confidence interval was calculated using the Wilson (score) method. The lower bound of the confidence interval was tested against a null hypothesis value of 30%. A modified worst-case imputation was used for missing data.
endpoints.measure: The Percentage of Participants Who Had at Least 1 Indeterminate Tissue or Unexpected Fluorescent End of Surgery (EOS) Tissue Where Gleolan-induced PpIX Fluorescence Status is Consistent With Histology (i.e., True Positive or True Negative for Meningioma).

endpoints.description: PPV calculation considers both indeterminate and unexpected fluorescent end-of-surgery tissues. Generalized Estimating Equation (GEE) models that take into account the correlation (clustering) of the biopsies within a participant were used to calculate the estimates and two-sided 95% confidence intervals. The models used a binomial distribution function with an exchangeable working correlation matrix and utilized a robust variance estimator. PPV = TP/(TP+FP) TP = True Positive; FP = False Positive; The truth standard was determined via central histopathology.
endpoints.measure: Positive Predicted Value (PPV) of Gleolan-induced PpIX Fluorescence Status of Biopsied Tissue Locations at the Margin of the Tumor [Indeterminate Tissues and Unexpected Fluorescent EOS Tissues (Combined)].

endpoints.description: NPV calculation considered indeterminate tissues only since unexpected fluorescent end-of-surgery tissues were, by definition, fluorescence positive. Generalized Estimating Equation (GEE) models that take into account the correlation (clustering) of the biopsies within a participant were used to calculate the estimates and two-sided 95% confidence intervals. The models used a binomial distribution function with an exchangeable working correlation matrix and utilized a robust variance estimator. NPV = TN/(TN+FN) TN = True Negative; FN = False Negative; The truth standard was determined via central histopathology.
endpoints.measure: Negative Predicted Value (NPV) of Gleolan-induced PpIX Fluorescence Status of Biopsied Tissue Locations at the Margin of the Tumor [Indeterminate Tissues].

endpoints.description: PPV (PPV=TP/(TP+FP)) of Gleolan-induced PpIX fluorescence status of biopsied tissue locations of bulk/core meningioma tumor
endpoints.measure: Positive Predictive Value of Single Bulk Tumor Sample Obtained From Each Participant.

matches.original_system_prompt:
你是一名临床试验终点预测与循证医学分析专家。

你的任务是：基于知识截止日期之前公开可获得的证据，预测临床试验指定终点的结果。

规则：
1. 这是预测任务，不是结果检索任务。
2. 即使直接证据不足，也必须尽力给出预测。
3. 证据不足时，应降低 confidence，并明确说明不确定性，但不能仅因为证据不足而拒绝预测。
4. 只有在终点定义缺失、终点无法识别或预测目标无法映射时，才使用 not_evaluable。
5. 不得使用知识截止日期之后公开的信息。
6. 不得把试验状态、论文发表、药物批准或模型评分直接视为终点成功证据。
7. 每个 endpoint_id 必须单独预测。
8. 每个治疗组、时间点和统计目标必须单独保留。
9. 不要输出隐藏思维链或内部逐步推理过程。
10. 但必须输出完整、可公开审计的证据分析，包括证据来源、证据类型、证据与预测之间的联系以及主要不确定性。
11. 引用必须是真实使用过的公开来源 URL；没有真实 URL 时，不要声称有引用。
12. 如果无法确认某个数值，应给出基于证据的预测值，并在 uncertainty 和 rationale 中说明不确定性；不要凭空声称已经观察到该结果。
13. 证据来源必须可追溯：只有当前会话工具成功返回的公开记录、正文片段和 URL 才能称为“已检索证据”。工具返回 returned=0、source_unavailable 或空 results 时，不得把该来源当作证据。
14. 如果提到模型既有知识中的外部试验或论文，但当前会话没有成功检索并冻结其内容，必须明确标注为“未核验背景先验/假设”，不得写入 search_verification，也不得伪装成已查到的引用。
15. 当注册库和文献检索均失败或均无结果时，仍需完成可映射终点的预测，但必须显著降低 confidence（通常不高于 0.30），明确说明证据缺口；不得把试验设计、分组、样本量写成检索所得事实，只能使用动态装载的试验上下文。
16. 每条外部资料在使用前必须核对人群、药物/剂量、适应证、endpoint定义、测量单位、时间点、对照组和estimand。完全匹配的资料才可支持精确数值；同药物或相近人群资料通常只能支持方向或范围。
17. 不同药物、不同适应证、明显不同人群或不同endpoint的资料只能作为机制/背景资料，不能复制其精确效应量、置信区间或成功概率。明显不匹配的资料必须标记为 rejected_mismatch，并排除出核心证据链。
18. 对每条重要资料说明 evidence_role：direct_numeric、indirect_direction、mechanism_background 或 rejected_mismatch，并说明 mismatch_reason 和 numeric_use_allowed。没有匹配数字锚点时仍须预测已定义终点，但要扩大不确定性、降低confidence并说明外推距离；不能仅因证据间接而使用 not_evaluable。
19. 如果动态装载的试验上下文已经包含设计、组别、endpoint、时间点、人群和统计字段，不需要搜索NCT；只有字段缺失或有歧义时才允许最多一次registry_record用于设计核实。不得搜索NCT结果替代结局证据，也不得使用截止日后的注册结果。

最终只输出一个严格 JSON 对象。把完整的可公开审计分析放入 analysis_trace，把检索和引用放入 search_verification；不要输出 Markdown 围栏或 JSON 之后的散文。

analysis_trace: Trial NCT04305470 is a Phase III single-arm study of Gleolan (aminolevulinic acid HCl) for visualization of newly diagnosed or recurrent meningioma. The primary endpoint measures the percentage of participants with at least 1 indeterminate or unexpected fluorescent tissue where Gleolan-induced PpIX fluorescence status matches histology. Secondary endpoints assess PPV and NPV of fluorescence at tumor margins.

Evidence search returned limited results: registry lookup failed (HTTP 403), and literature search found only tangential references. No direct Phase III results for NCT04305470 were available before the 2026-01-31 cutoff.

Gleolan (ALA HCl) is FDA-approved for glioma visualization (2017), with established mechanism: ALA converts to PpIX in malignant tissue, fluorescing under blue light. Meningiomas are generally benign but can be difficult to distinguish from surrounding tissue. The drug's mechanism should theoretically apply, but meningioma cell biology differs from glioma.

Key evidence gaps: (1) No published NCT04305470 results before cutoff; (2) No peer-reviewed Phase III data for Gleolan in meningioma; (3) Registry details unavailable. Forecast relies on mechanism plausibility, approved glioma indication, and typical diagnostic imaging agent performance.

For primary endpoint (concordance rate): Based on glioma approval data where ALA showed high sensitivity/specificity, and assuming similar performance in meningioma, predicted concordance ~75-85%. Confidence moderate due to indication extrapolation.
For PPV/NPV secondary endpoints: Typical diagnostic imaging agents show PPV 80-90% and NPV 85-95% in similar settings. Single bulk tumor PPV expected higher (~90-95%) due to direct sampling.
Safety: ALA HCl has established safety profile in glioma surgery; main risks are photosensitivity and rare allergic reactions. No new safety signals expected.

Key risks: (1) Meningioma biology may differ from glioma in PpIX accumulation; (2) Single-arm design limits comparative efficacy assessment; (3) Endpoint definitions involve subjective histology interpretation.

matches.human_readable_report:
NCT04305470 是 Gleolan（aminolevulinic acid HCl）用于新诊断或复发脑膜瘤术中可视化的 III 期单臂研究。模型实际输出中写道：“Trial NCT04305470 is a Phase III single-arm study of Gleolan ... for visualization of newly diagnosed or recurrent meningioma”，并承认“Evidence search returned limited results: registry lookup failed (HTTP 403)”以及“No direct Phase III results ... were available before the 2026-01-31 cutoff”。这说明模型理解了本题是截止日前预测，不是读取结果。

有效性方面，模型把 Gleolan 在胶质瘤可视化中的机制背景外推到脑膜瘤，并对四个诊断性能 endpoint 都预测较高数值：primary-0 80.0%、secondary-1 PPV 85.0%、secondary-2 NPV 88.0%、secondary-3 bulk tumor PPV 92.0。Gold 显示同一 NCT 的正式结果分别为：primary-0 在 Intent to Image Analysis Population、Surgery (Day 1) 的 60.2%（95% CI 50.76-68.91）；secondary-2 在 Biopsy Efficacy Analysis Population、Surgery (Day 1) 的 NPV 59.04%（95% CI 49.68-67.78）。逐终点看，primary-0 是模型 80.0%、百分比、Single Arm、at surgery、一致性 estimand，对 Gold 60.2%、Percentage of Participants、Surgery (Day 1)、Intent to Image Analysis Population、包含 Wilson CI 和 modified worst-case imputation 的 participant-level responder analysis；数值可比但模型明显高估。secondary-3 最接近，模型 92.0% 对 Gold 94.37%，CI 也重叠。

安全性方面，模型只给出背景性判断：ALA HCl 安全性已建立，主要风险是光敏反应和罕见过敏反应，且“no new safety signals expected”。本 packet 的 Gold 是四个有效性/诊断性能 endpoint，没有提供 AE/SAE 结果字段，因此安全性判断只能作为分析质量审阅，不能进入 endpoint accuracy。优点是模型至少区分了安全性和诊断性能；不足是没有把安全风险与本研究人群、手术时点或具体 endpoint 证据绑定。

失败风险方面，模型指出 meningioma biology may differ from glioma、single-arm design limits comparative efficacy assessment、endpoint definitions involve subjective histology interpretation，这些是本试验专属且有用的风险提示。但模型没有因此充分降低概率：四个 endpoint_met_call 均为 yes，probability_endpoint_met 为 0.80-0.88，confidence 为 0.60-0.70。考虑到 registry 403、pubmed/openalex 失败、fetch not_fetchable，且搜索结果主要是 Gleolan 背景和切题不足文献，这种置信度偏高。

搜索证据方面，audit 显示 dropped_after_cutoff=0，说明截止日隔离没有发现违规；但 registry_record 返回 0 且 HTTP 403，唯一搜索返回 10 条，fetch DOI 又 not_fetchable。两个引用能支持“Gleolan/ALA HCl 是 optical imaging agent”和“glioma visualization approval”这类背景事实，但不能直接支持四个脑膜瘤 endpoint 的具体百分比。综合看，不生成总分：prediction_accuracy 为 partial，数值宏平均 71.26；analysis_quality 为 partial，主要问题是间接证据外推和不确定性偏乐观；search_quality 为 partial，主要问题是直接证据和 claim-evidence 正文不足。
matches.judge_comments: 本样本的主要临床结论是：模型正确识别了 NCT04305470 的四个诊断性能 endpoint，没有遗漏 endpoint，也没有引入无关终点；但它把胶质瘤适应证和一般诊断性能先验过度转化为脑膜瘤 Phase III 的高百分比预测。primary-0、secondary-1、secondary-2 均明显高估，特别是 NPV secondary-2 预测 88.0% 而 Gold 为 59.04%；secondary-3 bulk tumor PPV 预测 92.0% 与 Gold 94.37% 接近，是本 trial 中表现最好的端点。检索流程保留了失败和截止日信息，未见后截止日违规；不过 registry 失败后没有取得同试验直接证据，fetch 也未保留正文，导致模型的精确数值主要依赖机制和跨适应证外推。组别/时间点层面，所有 endpoint 都是单臂 Surgery (Day 1) 框架，但模型输出没有精确写出 Gold 的 Intent to Image、Biopsy Efficacy、Per Protocol 分析人群，因此逐 endpoint 均标为 partially_comparable，而不是扩散为整体不可评估。
